description: Search recent regulatory / safety news from the Federal Register (filtered to OSHA) and the OSHA news RSS feed. Use for questions about recent rule changes, enforcement memos, or news that might affect a training course's content (e.g. 'any silica updates this year', 'recent fall protection rulemaking'). Returns titles, agencies, dates, URLs, and short summaries — pure pass-through, nothing is persisted. Prefer specific multi-word queries built around an OSHA topic or standard ('respirable silica §1926.1153', 'lockout tagout enforcement', 'fall protection 1926.501'). NOT for tenant-data questions; NOT for general OSHA reference (use search_law_corpus for established standards).

limit.description: Max results to return per source. Defaults to 6, cap 12.

query.description: Natural-language search terms. Best with topical keywords plus standard numbers when known.

name: search_regulatory_news
title: Search regulatory news
